entities.summary: Courtney Tremaine Upshaw is an American former professional football player who was an outside linebacker in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Alabama Crimson Tide, earning first-team All-American honors in 2011. He was selected by the Baltimore Ravens in the second round of the 2012 NFL draft.
